regulation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended, incl. G.S.R. 629(E) 2017 & G.S.R. 779(E) 2021) + FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
citation_source: Verified against the consolidated rule text: Rule 6(1)(a) manufacturer; 6(1)(aa) country of origin; 6(1)(b) generic name; 6(1)(c) net quantity; 6(1)(d) month & year of manufacture; 6(1)(da) best before/use by; 6(1)(e) MRP incl. of all taxes; Rule 6(2) consumer care contacts.

net_quantity.label: Net Quantity
net_quantity.rule_explanation: The net quantity must be declared in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l) or by number. Font size must be proportional to the principal display panel area (Schedule II).
net_quantity.pass_condition: Found with valid numeric value and standard unit
net_quantity.fail_condition: Completely absent from all visible panels
net_quantity.warning_condition: Detected on package flap/bottom (flap pointer found)
net_quantity.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 25,000 for first offence (Section 36, LMA 2009)

mrp.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
mrp.rule_explanation: MRP must be declared in Indian Rupees, inclusive of all taxes, and rounded to the nearest rupee or 50 paise. Unit Sale Price declaration additionally applies per the 2021 amendment (G.S.R. 779(E)).
mrp.pass_condition: MRP found with Rs./₹ symbol, numeric value, and 'inclusive of all taxes' wording
mrp.fail_condition: MRP not found on any visible panel
mrp.warning_condition: MRP found but missing 'inclusive of all taxes' statement, or pointed to package flap/bottom
mrp.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 25,000 (Section 36); selling above MRP: up to Rs. 1,00,000 and/or imprisonment (Section 18, LMA 2009)

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer / Packer Name & Address
manufacturer.rule_explanation: Complete name and address of the manufacturer (and packer, if different), or importer for imported packages, must appear on the package.
manufacturer.pass_condition: 'Manufactured by', 'Packed by', 'Marketed by', or 'Imported by' found with name and address

manufacture_date.label: Month & Year of Manufacture
manufacture_date.rule_explanation: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed (or imported) must be declared, e.g. MM/YYYY or 'Oct 2026'.
manufacture_date.pass_condition: MFG date found in valid date format

use_by.label: Best Before / Use By / Expiry Date
use_by.rule_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1)(da) (inserted by 2017 Amendment)
use_by.rule_explanation: For commodities that deteriorate (e.g. food), the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month and year must be declared on the label.
use_by.pass_condition: Expiry/BBD date found in valid format
use_by.fail_condition: No expiry or best-before date found
use_by.warning_condition: Expiry date found on package flap/bottom
use_by.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 25,000 (Section 36, LMA 2009); selling past expiry is a separate offence

consumer_care.label: Consumer Care Details
consumer_care.rule_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(2) (inserted by 2017 Amendment, G.S.R. 629(E))
consumer_care.rule_explanation: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person or office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
consumer_care.pass_condition: Phone number or email address found associated with consumer/customer/helpline keyword
consumer_care.warning_condition: Contact found but without consumer-care keyword context

fssai.label: FSSAI License Number
fssai.rule_citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Clause 2.1.1
fssai.rule_explanation: Every pre-packaged food must carry the FSSAI logo and the 14-digit license/registration number of the manufacturer or brand owner.
fssai.warning_condition: Partial FSSAI reference found without full 14-digit number
fssai.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 5 lakh and/or licence cancellation (FSS Act, 2006)

country_of_origin.label: Country of Origin
country_of_origin.rule_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1)(aa) (inserted by 2017 Amendment)
country_of_origin.rule_explanation: For imported packages, the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly must be declared. Domestic manufacture may be evident from a complete Indian manufacturer address under Rule 6(1)(a).
country_of_origin.pass_condition: 'Made in', 'Manufactured in', 'Product of', 'Country of Origin' found, or Indian manufacturer address present
country_of_origin.fail_condition: No country of origin declaration found
country_of_origin.warning_condition: Not applicable — either found or missing
country_of_origin.penalty: Fine up to Rs. 25,000 (Section 36, LMA 2009); customs implications for unmarked imports
